documents.text: Gmina Pilica Gmina Pilica is an urban-rural gmina (administrative district) in Zawiercie County, Silesian Voivodeship, in southern Poland. Its seat is the town of Pilica, which lies approximately east of Zawiercie and north-east of the regional capital Katowice. The gmina covers an area of , and as of 2006 its total population is 9,117 (out of which the population of Pilica amounts to 1,971, and the population of the rural part of the gmina is 7,146). Apart from the town of Pilica, Gmina Pilica contains the villages and settlements of Biskupice, Cisowa, Dobra, Dobra-Kolonia, Dobraków, Dzwono-Sierbowice, Dzwonowice, Jasieniec, Kidów, Kleszczowa,
